title: What's On Guide
slide_intent: Teach designers to make editions recognizable as a series while giving each quarter its own subject and color.
strategic_value: The museum can signal continuity across changing activities by fixing the title, date and seal while varying the photography and ground.
demonstration: Three aligned covers use pink, blue and dark green. Each runs a photograph edge to edge beneath the large What’s On title with the date and seal above and visitor information below.
practical_value: For the next issue, replace the photograph, quarter and color while retaining the common hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Quarterly cover comparison
content_islands.spec: Set three equal portrait covers in a row. Keep the quarter at upper left and seal at upper right on each.

content_islands.name: Cover structure
content_islands.spec: Anchor the title just above a full-width landscape photo. Reserve the lower color field for venue names, entry information and the web address.
